summary_md: **Jakub ([@foobar_beer](https://x.com/foobar_beer/status/2115082462166450627))** ships **Neoize**, a Claude Code plugin that turns project knowledge — code structure, lessons learned, operational knowledge — into a local searchable Neo4j graph, so Claude pulls relevant nodes instead of grepping Markdown. In replies Jakub explains a `/neoize:wrap` skill run at session end to update the graph.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - foobar-beer/claude-neoize: Turn a codebase and its hard-won knowledge into a local Neo4j graph Claude Code queries by relevance. A plugin.

relevance: A graph-backed memory alternative to markdown notes for coding-agent context.

media.description: Neo4j Browser graph view of a large knowledge graph (14,207 nodes, 26,454 relationships) with node labels such as Artifact, Feature, File, Lesson, Operation, Protocol and Symbol, built by the Neoize plugin for agent sessions.
